candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from downstream latency: order's call to payment times out (ReadTimeout, ~2s) while inventory/redis succeed, so order returns 502 to gateway checkout. Payment's own /v1/authorizations later returns 200, indicating slow-but-alive payment rather than hard failure.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side latency metrics or logs; excluded gw_logs may clarify. Cannot distinguish payment slowness from network/transport issue.

report.explanation: Traces show repeated checkout 502s caused by order->payment ReadTimeout (~2s) while inventory/redis succeed; gateway p95 checkout latency ~2406ms and 502 rate elevated. Topology confirms order->payment dependency. Bounded to downstream latency; payment-side evidence missing.
